scope: Independent read-only review of optional high-speed harness delta; no runtime/source edits or native execution.

solo-chase old analysis unchanged except added null highSpeed output
solo-manual-camera old analysis unchanged except added null highSpeed output
solo-reduced-motion old analysis unchanged except added null highSpeed output
solo-pause-cancel old analysis unchanged except added null highSpeed output
Synthetic valid >30m/s case retains passing original and authored gates
High-speed rejects rigid fallback even with speed and pacing valid
Original reduced motion pause pace camera restoration and letterbox gate block byte-identical

review.defaultCases: Exact original four remain default; explicit INKSTORM_COMBAT_CASES=solo-high-speed opts in. Existing native cadence restriction remains solo-chase only.
review.ordinaryInput: New case releases S and holds W after actual countdown (raceTime>0.1), then uses unchanged1300ms prewindow and native Shift to cause actual overheat. No health/heat/position/speed writes, event injection, course staging or simulation stepping added.
review.speedGate: Last running sample strictly before authoritative wreck frame must have finite speed>30m/s and nonnegative cue gap<120ms. Matching actual redline explosion/wreck is still required. This is sampled pre-impact speed, not exact instantaneous collision speed.
review.authoredGate: Accelerating case now shares original solo-chase requirement:>=3 already-rendered non-birth matte wreck samples, Teemto, breakup/damage available+active, no damage error. Valid fallback cannot count as acceptance.
review.unchangedGates: Existing scheduling windows/thresholds, pause/reduced-motion behavior, shot camera, camera restoration, matte duration, full recovery and ordinary drive assertions remain unchanged. Baseline output gains highSpeed:null; each saved V18 baseline analysis is otherwise exactly reproduced.
review.observer: Adds read-only speed scalar and copied three-component position to existing25ms observer. No observer frequency or scheduling measurement formula changes. This extra observation work remains included in native measurements.
review.samplingLimit: <120ms pre-cue criterion provides a bounded sampled pre-impact witness; it cannot prove speed continuously or at the exact physics tick. Existing screenshot/recording overhead remains excluded from performance acceptance by original scope.
review.critic: No critic code or criteria changes are present in this source delta; four-case default selection preserved. This review does not constitute high-speed native or visual acceptance.

cpuTests: Synthetic derivatives of saved V18 samples are in-memory analyzer contract tests only. They are not native evidence and are not written over recordings.
